scope: Static read-only review of BlastEm SMS bounded private backend, plus authorized parser selfcheck; no native emulator run by reviewer

self_checks.output: [SELF-CHECK OK] BlastEm SMS script bounds, machine, PAL and injection rejection
self_checks.scope: Parser bounds, model/region, raw step-command injection; does not exercise lifecycle, debugger, capture or ROM input

findings.title: Baseline proof flag can be true without any ROM applicability assertion
findings.detail: After baseline dumps, baseline_checked_before_input is set True even when preconditions is omitted or empty. The sequence validates with no preconditions; completed and this boolean cannot prove the intended fight/menu state was reached.
findings.recommendation: Record precondition count and explicit status not_requested vs passed; workflow/bundle auditor must require applicable preconditions before claiming a specific tested case.

findings.title: Baseline dump width checked only after all inputs
findings.detail: first_ram is sliced for declared magic without confirming its full8192-byte length. A short prefix can match a precondition, allowing input before the final dump-size gate rejects it. Other baseline dump widths are likewise deferred.
findings.recommendation: Validate every baseline dump expected size before the first binding input, then evaluate ROM preconditions.

findings.title: Cleanup exception prevents remaining cleanup and failure evidence
findings.detail: finally calls terminate_group(p), terminate_group(x), closes FDs and writes metadata sequentially. TimeoutExpired/OSError in the first call skips Xvfb termination, descriptor closure and final session.json. terminate_group has a second wait(timeout3) that can raise.
findings.recommendation: Attempt emulator and Xvfb cleanup independently in nested try/finally; aggregate errors, attempt every FD close, write failed cleanup metadata and reject promotion.

findings.title: Malformed precondition types lack explicit validation
findings.detail: preconditions itself is not checked as a list and equals_hex is not checked as a string before bytes.fromhex. Values such as preconditions:null or equals_hex:true raise TypeError; main catches neither TypeError nor AttributeError. This is a rejection rather than false acceptance, but yields traceback instead of the promised structured failure.
findings.recommendation: Validate list and equals_hex string explicitly; reject unknown top-level fields to detect misspelled preconditions before boot.

findings.title: Informative screenshot flag is advisory, not a visual pass
findings.detail: A monochrome256x192 screenshot sets screenshot_informative False but can still end state completed. A real blank screen may be valid diagnostic state; consumers must distinguish execution completion from usable visual evidence.
findings.recommendation: Bundle visual eligibility must reject non-informative capture; retain RAM-only diagnostics with explicit limited scope.

findings.title: Runtime package manifest is local integrity, not an independent immutable archive proof
findings.detail: Binary hash is independently pinned. Supporting files are checked against mutable installation.json and no required supporting-file inventory is enforced beyond blastem. This protects ordinary drift for inventoried assets, not intentional/reduced manifest edits.
findings.recommendation: At minimum require known supporting files and hash the installation manifest in session provenance. Do not claim full release authenticity from the nominal archive hash alone.

verified_strengths: Private Xvfb allocated with displayfd, cookie and TCP disabled; bwrap exposes only its X socket inside private/tmp. Environment strips SDL/LD and desktop/audio variables, fixesX11/softwareGL and uses dummy audio; /dev is private.
No physical/host joystick required: debugger binddown/bindup is process local. Forced -m sms, preserved rom.sms, sms1/sms2 config and correct SMS1/2 bindings b/c avoid MD/PBC inheritance.
Current code explicitly rejects SDL renderer fallback/GLEW initialization failure. Snapshot dimensions and dump sizes are validated before completed.
PTY prevents debugger desktop-terminal bootstrap; per-command markers serialize stepping; boundaries enforce requested VDP deltas. Internal cycle is correctly limited and is not FPS or CPU duration.
PAL and MD models rejected, limits1..3600frames, dummy audio not tested, fps_claim/hardware_validationFalse and diagnostic_states_only ceilings explicit.
Observed historical root session is failed with both cleanup booleans true and no fabricated boundaries/CPU claims. Its wrapper hash differs from current source and it is not a current runtime PASS.
limits: No emulator started by this reviewer; debugger, current render calibration, native P1/P2 input and pause/NMI remain outside this review.
Selfcheck does not exercise run() lifecycle or renderer fallback; request targeted negatives in parent QA.
No artistic judgment, 60FPS claim, audio/music claim, fight-mechanics approval or game delivery.
Read-only source inspection; only report/source snapshot under /tmp/smsforge-blastem-native-review written.
No SGDK changes or luta_mugen/doc access.
next_action: Fix lifecycle/baseline metadata weaknesses, add bundle auditor and private workflow; then native acceptance on SMS oracle plus real ROM for exact SHA, including failed precondition, short dump, renderer fallback and pause/each input.
